## LXG-03 Instantly Enrollment
Enrolls QUALIFIED leads into the right Instantly campaign and records the result.
Instantly then sends Email 1 (Day 1), Email 2 (Day 4), Email 3 (Day 9) — timing is configured **in Instantly**.

**Safety:** `DRY_RUN=true` (default) sends nothing. **Ramp:** `DAILY_ENROLL_CAP`, `ENROLL_BATCH_SIZE`.
Suppressed addresses are re-checked here and never enrolled.

nodes.name: Instantly: Add Lead
nodes.notes: Instantly API v2 POST /leads. Retries 3x, then goes to the error output (lead marked ERROR).
